```{r}
library(gllvm)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmnet)
data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
Xenv[1:6, ]
Xenv[, 1:3]

Xenv_u_df = microbial %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "site") %>% 
  select(site, Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype) %>% 
  mutate(u = rnorm(nrow(microbial), 0, 1) # simulating for 1 latent variable
)

#df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
#    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))

df = microbial %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "site") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Y.OTU"),
               names_to = "spid",
               values_to = "abundance")

site_cols = df %>% distinct(site) %>% pull(site) %>% sort()
#site_cols_renamed = paste0("site", seq_along(site_cols))

df_with_Xenv_u = df %>% 
  left_join(Xenv_u_df, by = "site") %>% 
  select(-ends_with(".x")) %>% 
  rename_with( ~ str_remove(., "\\.y"), ends_with(".y")) 

df_site_onehot = df_with_Xenv_u %>%
  arrange(site, spid) %>% 
  mutate(dummy = 1, row_id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(row_id, spid, abundance, names(Xenv_u_df)[-1]),
    names_from = site,
    values_from = dummy,
    values_fill = 0
  )

result_list = list()
for (s in site_cols) {
  block = df_site_onehot %>% 
    filter(.data[[s]] == 1) %>% 
    mutate(spid_num = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+"))) %>% 
    arrange(spid_num) %>% 
    select(-spid, -row_id) %>% 
    relocate(spid_num, .before = everything())
  result_list[[s]] = block
}

df_site_onehot = bind_rows(result_list)
new_names = setNames(site_cols, paste0("site", seq_along(site_cols)))
df_site_onehot = df_site_onehot %>% 
  rename(!!!new_names)
```

```{r alternating glmnet for penalising lambda, u, individual site updates}

chosen_spid = unique(df_site_onehot$spid_num)[1:200]
#subset
df_site_onehot = df_site_onehot[df_site_onehot$spid_num %in% chosen_spid, ]

beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = length(chosen_spid), ncol = 4)
#X_full = matrix(NA, nrow = length(chosen_spid)*nrow(microbial), ncol = 3)
new_Xenv = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 3) #56 x 3
new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1

site_col_name = paste0("site", seq_along(site_cols))
site_matrix = as.matrix(df_site_onehot[, site_col_name])

N = 20
loglik = -Inf
  
for (k in 1:N){
  for (j in seq_along(chosen_spid)){
    i = chosen_spid[j]
    X = cbind(df_site_onehot$Xenv.SOM[df_site_onehot$spid_num == i], df_site_onehot$Xenv.pH[df_site_onehot$spid_num == i], df_site_onehot$u[df_site_onehot$spid_num == i])
    glmnet1 = glmnet(x = X, y = df_site_onehot$abundance[df_site_onehot$spid_num == i], intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 1)
    #Y[, j] = abundance[spid_num == i]
    #row_start = 1 + (j-1)*nrow(microbial)
    #row_end = j*nrow(microbial)
    #X_full[row_start:row_end, ] = X
    beta_lambda[j, ] = t(c(glmnet1$a0, as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))) #1 x 3, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
  }
  
  beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
  lambda = beta_lambda[, 4] #200 x 1
  #Y = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = length(chosen_spid))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(microbial)){
    site_indicator = site_matrix[, i]
    block = df_site_onehot[site_indicator == 1, ] #remove for joint
    new_X_full = cbind(1, block$Xenv.SOM, block$Xenv.pH)[1, ] #1 x 3 #remove for joint
    
    new_Xenv[i, ] = new_X_full
    
    glmnet1 = glmnet(x = cbind(lambda, rep(0, length(lambda))), y = block$abundance, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = as.numeric(new_X_full%*%t(beta)), alpha = 0, lambda = 1)
    new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(glmnet1$beta)[1]) #to drop the extra 0 column
  }
  u = new_u #56 x 1
  u
  eta = new_Xenv%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200 -- need to work out what new_X_full is 
  mu = exp(eta)
  loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(df_site_onehot$abundance, lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
  cat("iter", k, "loglik:", loglik_new, "\n")

  if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
  loglik = loglik_new}
k

```


```{r alternating glmnet for penalising lambda, u, difference in site update -- joint now}

chosen_spid = unique(df_site_onehot$spid_num)[1:200]
n_species = length(chosen_spid)

#subset
df_site_onehot = df_site_onehot[df_site_onehot$spid_num %in% chosen_spid, ]

beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = length(chosen_spid), ncol = 4)
X_full = cbind(1, df_site_onehot$Xenv.SOM, df_site_onehot$Xenv.pH)
new_Xenv = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 3) #56 x 3
new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = 1) #56 x 1

site_col_name = paste0("site", seq_along(site_cols))
site_matrix = as.matrix(df_site_onehot[, site_col_name])

N = 20
loglik = -Inf
  
for (k in 1:N){
  for (j in seq_along(chosen_spid)){
    i = chosen_spid[j]
    X = cbind(df_site_onehot$Xenv.SOM[df_site_onehot$spid_num == i], df_site_onehot$Xenv.pH[df_site_onehot$spid_num == i], df_site_onehot$u[df_site_onehot$spid_num == i])
    glmnet1 = glmnet(x = X, y = df_site_onehot$abundance[df_site_onehot$spid_num == i], intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), alpha = 0, lambda = 1)
    #Y[, j] = abundance[spid_num == i]
    #row_start = 1 + (j-1)*nrow(microbial)
    #row_end = j*nrow(microbial)
    #X_full[row_start:row_end, ] = X
    beta_lambda[j, ] = t(c(glmnet1$a0, as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))) #1 x 3, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
  }
  
  beta_lambda #(intercept beta lambda)
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:3] #200 x 3
  lambda = beta_lambda[, 4] #200 x 1
  #Y = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(microbial), ncol = length(chosen_spid))
  
  lambda_named = setNames(lambda, chosen_spid)
  lambda_rep = lambda_named[as.character(df_site_onehot$spid_num)] #11200 x 1
  X_joint = site_matrix * lambda_rep #11200 x 56 elementwise multiplication, multiply row r of site_matrix by lambda_rep[r], for every column
  offset_matrix = X_full%*%t(beta) #11200 x 200
  
  # for each row, pick the column matching that row's own species
  species_col_idx = match(df_site_onehot$spid_num, chosen_spid) #11200 x 1
  offset_full = offset_matrix[cbind(seq_len(nrow(df_site_onehot)), species_col_idx)] #matrix indexing: pick one value per row; returns 11200 values = offset_matrix[row_idx, col_idx], e.g. offset_matrix[201, 1]
    
  glmnet1 = glmnet(x = X_joint, y = df_site_onehot$abundance, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = as.numeric(offset_full), alpha = 0, lambda = 1)
  new_u = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta) 
    
  u = new_u #56 x 1
  u
  site_rows = seq(1, nrow(X_full), by = n_species)
  eta = X_full[site_rows, ]%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
  mu = exp(eta)
  loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(df_site_onehot$abundance, lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
  cat("iter", k, "loglik:", loglik_new, "\n")
  if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
  loglik = loglik_new}
k
